task_instance: Scaffold a minimal 'tool-only' ChatGPT Apps SDK app (no widget) for a Stoic-quote assistant: classify the archetype, write a tool plan for a single get_quote tool (schema, description, annotations), hand-write an MCP server scaffold (server/index.mjs + package.json) registering that tool per documented Apps SDK/MCP server patterns, write local-run + ngrok + ChatGPT Developer Mode connection instructions, and produce a validation report against the skill's minimum working repo contract.
blocker_detail: Full docs-first grounding was partially degraded: WebFetch on developers.openai.com, mcpcat.io and mcpui.dev was blocked by the sandbox's network egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), so the primary Apps SDK doc pages could not be fetched directly. WebSearch still worked and returned real quoted snippets from the same OpenAI docs (install command, text/html;profile=mcp-app MIME type, openai/outputTemplate alias), which were used to ground the scaffold, consistent with the skill's own fallback instruction not to let search/fetch trouble block scaffolding. This did not block the core deliverable, so it is reported as a note rather than the task's blocker.
evidence: Produced text-file deliverables under the work directory: tool-plan.md (archetype classification 'tool-only', tool schema/annotations for get_quote, architecture rationale), server/package.json and server/index.mjs (a complete, hand-written MCP server using @modelcontextprotocol/sdk's McpServer + StreamableHTTPServerTransport, registering get_quote with a Zod input schema, accurate annotations matching real handler behavior (idempotentHint:false because selection is random), and returning both content and structuredContent per the documented contract), README.md (file tree, local run steps, ngrok tunnel step, ChatGPT Developer Mode connector setup steps, and a note on refreshing after descriptor changes), and VALIDATION.md (an explicit static contract review checklist covering repo shape, tool descriptors/annotations, dependency/run script completeness, and setup docs, plus an explicit list of what was not run: npm install, node index.mjs, any /mcp health check, MCP Inspector, or live ChatGPT test, all of which require code execution this runtime does not grant). Verification method: manual read-through of index.mjs against the Apps SDK server contract recovered via WebSearch snippets (tool registration shape, structuredContent/content/_meta separation, readOnlyHint/destructiveHint/openWorldHint/idempotentHint annotation names) plus a self-consistency check that annotations match the handler's actual (non-idempotent, read-only, closed-world) behavior. No code was executed and no binary files were produced, per the runtime's constraints; the skill itself treats a statically-reviewed, not-yet-run scaffold as a legitimate deliverable as long as the response states exactly what validation was and was not performed, which VALIDATION.md does.
